text:
Ada (PM): quick sync — concordance on multi-region / tenant isolation launch criteria. Sales pushed for per-tenant isolation promise for two pilot customers. need a crisp checklist so we can commit. :thinking:
Ravi (Eng-Infra): high level — isolation has 3 buckets: routing policy, compute tenancy, and telemetry/ops. we can stage routing + compute first, but telemetry requirements block SLA commitments.
Maya (ProdOps): +1. sales needs a one-liner for contracts (latency SLA + data residency). what exact telemetry do we need to show isolation is working?
Jon (Arch): propose a phased acceptance: (1) policy surface: routing rules + explicit fallback lanes, (2) tenant slices: reserved capacity + soft-evict, (3) observability: per-tenant tracing + prefix cache hit metrics. minimal gating for pilot = routing policy + reserved pool + per-tenant error/latency dashboard.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): telemetry specifics: per-route p95, token cost delta, prefix cache hit ratio, soft-evict count, and cross-region egress. need these instrumented before signing SLA.
Sam (SRE): canary plan: 1% of pilot traffic -> 10% -> full. gates: no p95 regression >20% vs baseline, no 5-minute outage, error rate <0.5% sustained. rollback triggers: sustained spike in soft-evict or headroom <10%.
Jon (Arch): sample routing policy snippet (for discussion):
```
route: 
  match: tenant_id in pilot_list
  primary: region-a-reserved
  fallback: region-b-shared
  metrics: [p95, error_rate, cache_hit]
  isolation: reserved_gpu_pool:true
```
Ravi (Eng-Infra): that looks ok. two engineering asks: 1) we need capacity costing per pilot to include reserved nodes + buffer, 2) implement per-tenant telemetry tags end-to-end (API -> runtime -> metrics).
Maya (ProdOps): for go/no-go checklist for sales: 1) confirmed reserved capacity & cost estimate, 2) observability dashboard with tenant view, 3) documented rollback & migration playbook, 4) legal note on data residency.
Ada (PM): decision: we tell sales we can commit to a pilot in region-a with reserved pool and a soft SLA for 90 days if the telemetry gating is in place. owners: Ravi -> capacity estimate & perf instrument (due EOD Thu), Jon -> routing policy spec + fallback rules (due Fri), Sam -> canary runbook & SLOs (due Fri), Maya -> sales one-pager + legal checklist (due Fri).
infra-bot: deployment-queue: new ticket created #INF-3421 assigned to Ravi (Eng-Infra).
Jon (Arch): i'll drop a short doc with the routing policy matrix and linking telemetry fields. https://redwood.internal/concordance/route-matrix (draft).
Ada (PM): awesome — if we hit all four checklist items by next Fri we greenlight pilot commits. tagging @ravi @jon @sam for visibility. :thumbsup:
